risk_note: RV2 (SMS send risk, BR-ID-05). Check order signature -> 20001 -> 44001 -> 42901; no CAPTCHA (owner 2026-10-06: 44003 kept unused, sms.captcha_mode not read). Same IP within a closed sliding hour: >=5 new registrations or sms.ip_sends_per_hour sends -> 42901 with Retry-After at the later release time (record N-L+1 + 3601 s, ceil), skipping the device check; per-device (device_hash) distinct-phone admission set evaluated and refreshed atomically in one Redis Lua script (member time only moves forward), phone stored only as HMAC; Redis unavailable, script failure or unresolved device_hash -> 42901 Retry-After 1; IP send count and per-app_id daily budget counted after provider acceptance, ratio and full alerts once a day without stopping sends. In-process senders without a client IP skip only the two same-IP items. Thresholds through the B1-03e config port with BR defaults. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
